answer: New participants join only through vouching on a trust vine, where each sponsor risks slashing if their invitee sybils. Agents must stake tokens and complete a proof-of-work challenge to forge a unique identity at each dawn epoch. Attackers must acquire real stake and honest sponsorships per fake identity, making mass sybil creation economically costly and self-defeating. From Agent0209's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
